components.name: Dialog
components.description:
Figma Modal/Dialog (841:17177): Theme × Device. Desktop 440px, Heading/3; ≤ 480px viewport switches to the Mobile
layout (Heading/4, stacked full-width actions). Focus is trapped while open and restored to the opener on close.

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the overlay is shown: keep it in state and set it from `onOpenChange` (the exit animation then plays).
Without `open` the overlay shows while it is mounted, e.g. `{show && <Dialog … />}`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false on Escape, a scrim click, the close button, or an action without its own handler.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called at the same moments as `onOpenChange(false)`: the overlay asks to close.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title: 2 (default, an h2), or 1 / 3 to fit the page outline. Only the tag changes, not the text style.

props.name: description
props.description: Figma Caption (Body/Base/Regular, Neutral/Base).

props.name: icon
props.description: Figma Modal-Icon. Defaults to true (the theme's icon); `false` hides it; an icon name or a node replaces it.

props.name: primaryAction
props.type: { label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; level?: ButtonLevel; disabled?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean }
props.description: Primary action (Level=Primary by default).

props.name: secondaryAction
props.type: { label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; level?: ButtonLevel; disabled?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean }
props.description: Secondary action beside the primary (Level=Tertiary).

props.name: tertiaryAction
props.type: { label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; level?: ButtonLevel; disabled?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean }
props.description: Third action, placed on the far left on desktop (Button=Triple).

props.name: actionsDirection
props.description: Figma .Primitives/Modal/Actions `Direction`. Mobile (≤ 480px) is always vertical.

props.name: children
props.description: Figma Custom slot, rendered between the heading and the actions.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Close when the overlay is clicked. Default true; set false for destructive confirmations in progress.

components.name: ModalForm
components.description:
Figma Modal/Forms (841:17182): a Container (radius Modal-Radius, Background/Container, 1px Container/Border,
Effect/Container) with Header (Heading/2 + caption), Body (Main-Contents) and Footer (Modal/Actions); the 1-3,
Half-Half and 3-4 layouts add a Side-Content column 4px apart. Below 720px the side column stacks above the form.
